projects.title: Špansko Swimming Pools
projects.description: Fire protection of the Špansko municipal swimming pool complex. Cladding of ventilation ducts with fire-rated boards, firestopping of penetrations and protection of the steel structure in the plant room and technical areas.
scope: Protection of the steel structure with fire-rated coatings

projects.title: KBC Sestre milosrdnice University Hospital
projects.description: A complex fire protection project for the hospital complex. It included firestopping of service penetrations, installation of fire-rated doors and fire-rated cladding.

projects.title: BHB Residential & Office Building
projects.description: A residential and office building with the highest fire protection standards. The project included complete passive fire protection from the foundations to the roof.
scope: Fire-rated spandrel panels on the facade

projects.title: Sljeme Cable Car
projects.description: Fire protection of the new Sljeme cable car complex. A particular challenge was carrying out the protection works in demanding mountain conditions.
